title: Accept a wrong spelling answer as an alias

intentCoverage.report:
Verdict: Caught. The maintained tests catch the fault on the existing-aliases-list path of C2.

Story and revision: SEED-073#accept-spelling-answer-as-alias (plan .planning/slice-plans/104-accept-spelling-answer-as-alias, C2 "one click writes the typed answer into the reviewed note's aliases"). Checked revision ebb2062a7f29b5cd80e5669eda68de40d54b94de in a separate detached scratch worktree; its `git status --short` was empty before the probe.

Fault: frontend/src/utils/frontmatterStringList.ts, appendItemToFrontmatterStringList, existing-list branch: `[existingKey]: listPropertyValue(merged)` became `listPropertyValue([trimmedItem])`, dropping existing items. appendAliasToNoteContent calls this function. No fixtures or assertions changed.

Independent wrong-behavior witness: a temporary scratch spec (deleted afterwards) called appendAliasToNoteContent("---\naliases:\n  - 伝手\n---\nSome body", "つてを頼る") with the fault in place and received "---\naliases:\n  - つてを頼る\n---\nSome body"; the existing alias 伝手 was lost.

Maintained checks (`env -u NODE_ENV CURSOR_DEV=true nix develop -c pnpm vitest run tests/utils/appendAliasToNoteContent.spec.ts tests/utils/frontmatterStringList.spec.ts tests/components/recall/AnsweredSpellingQuestionAddAnswerAsAlias.spec.ts` from frontend/):
- Baseline: 3 files, 23 tests passed.
- With fault: 2 failed, 21 passed. Caught by tests/utils/appendAliasToNoteContent.spec.ts "merges a new alias into an existing aliases list" (whole-markdown toBe; the relocated test still catches it) and tests/utils/frontmatterStringList.spec.ts "creates or merges into a named list key" (expected ['alpha','beta'], received ['beta']).
- Not caught by AnsweredSpellingQuestionAddAnswerAsAlias.spec.ts: its one-click test starts from a note without frontmatter, so the existing-list path is caught at the utility level only.

Restoration: fault reverted, scratch spec deleted, `git status --short` identical to before (empty), the same command passed again (3 files, 23 tests), scratch worktree removed.

Next proof action: none required for this promise. Optional: start the component one-click test from a note that already has an aliases list.

Timing: invocation started 2026-11-18T00:01:20+0800; invocation-to-report elapsed 141213 ms. Test durations 9.12 s / 8.95 s / 7.26 s; dependency setup about 40 s (estimated).

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision ebb2062a7f29b5cd80e5669eda68de40d54b94de, verdict Caught, no follow-up.
